outputs.justification: The URL is valid and resolves to the TargetScan release 8.0 site (miRNA target prediction resource) which provides searchable/publishable target prediction data and tools for retrieving predicted miRNA targets. ([targetscan.org](https://www.targetscan.org/vert_80/?utm_source=openai))

The manuscript states the RNA‑seq data were deposited in BioStudies under accession S-BSST2081 (see article Data Availability). However, as of Feb 11, 2026 the accession S-BSST2081 does not resolve to a publicly accessible BioStudies record / could not be found in public BioStudies indexes. Possible explanations: the record is still under embargo/private, the accession contains a typographical error, or the record has not been released by the submitter. The article’s Data Availability statement referencing S-BSST2081 is documented in the published record. ([embopress.org](https://www.embopress.org/doi/10.1038/s44321-025-00273-9?utm_source=openai))
